title: Regions and Availability Zones
summary: An AWS Region is a geographic area. It contains separate Availability Zones designed to reduce shared failure risks.
introduction: An AWS Region is a geographic area. It contains separate Availability Zones designed to reduce shared failure risks. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: An AWS Region is a geographic area. It contains separate Availability Zones designed to reduce shared failure risks.

blocks.title: Regions and Availability Zones

blocks.text: The Region and Zone names describe different levels of location. Zone letter mappings can differ between accounts.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Draw a Region containing more than one Zone.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not assume two Zones are the same physical building.
For more detail later, use this [AWS further reading](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-overview/introduction.html).
